commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: What is called petty understanding? It is the delusion of thinking well of yourself and saying, “I have sound understanding.” The word means understanding that hasn’t ripened. It is called delusion because such people know the world scorns them and think this all the same.
